# Deep Orbit Protocol

## Act I: The Ghost Pulse
Deep in Jovian space, Hermes VII was meant to be a decommissioned survey frigate running automated scrap scans. But Captain Vane caught an anomalous microwave beacon emanating from a shattered obsidian monolith in low Europa orbit.

When the sensor array locked onto the frequency, the carrier wave did not contain navigational telemetry. It was a digital echo repeating a single phrase in an archaic naval cipher.
